readings: For each team, what is its average half-season win rate (wins `w` divided by games managed `g` for each `manager_half` record, averaged and ignoring missing values) and how many `manager_half` records does it have? Also show how far its average is above the mean of all the team averages (ignoring missing ones, and only if that mean exists). List `team_id`, average win rate, record count and the difference, sorted by the difference from highest to lowest with missing values last, top 10.
queries:
WITH team_avg AS (
    SELECT team_id,
           AVG(CAST(w AS REAL) / g) AS avg_win_rate,
           COUNT(*) AS record_count
    FROM manager_half
    GROUP BY team_id
)
SELECT team_id,
       avg_win_rate,
       record_count,
       avg_win_rate - (SELECT AVG(avg_win_rate) FROM team_avg) AS diff
FROM team_avg
ORDER BY diff DESC
LIMIT 10;
